title: Player One snapshots are processed as streaming frames
description:
- Location: indigo_drivers/ccd_playerone/indigo_ccd_playerone.driver:413; finish behavior at 335-355. Cross-component contract: indigo_libs/indigo_ccd_driver.c:1806-1815,2316-2328. - Severity: medium; confidence: high; category: functional/image delivery. Owner: coordinator; status: open; nonblocking follow-up. - Evidence: the shared snapshot/stream acquisition finalizer passes literal true for indigo_process_image's final streaming argument, even when PRIVATE_DATA->streaming is false. The base framework applies streaming update throttling and selects AVI/SER file output only when this argument is true. acquisition_finish finalizes video only when PRIVATE_DATA->streaming is actually true. - Impact: single exposures can be throttled like streams and JPEG_AVI/RAW_SER single exposures can create video files without the ordinary single-image/finalization behavior. SDK continuous-acquisition workarounds do not make a public single exposure a streaming operation. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (AC-4). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
